annotations.title: Browse OffLadder's career guides by topic

description: Lists every OffLadder career guide on one subject, as questions with links, so someone can see what there is to read before picking one, e.g. 'show me everything on interviews', 'what guides do you have for students', 'reading list for after a layoff', 'what do you have on AI and jobs', 'guides on finding remote work', 'everything about resigning and notice periods'. Shelves: stuck (Not sure what to do next), jobs (Job by job: is it for me, how to get in, where it's heading), career-change (Changing careers), layoffs (After a layoff or redundancy), ai (AI, jobs and the future of work), job-search (Job searching and being found), applying (CVs, resumes, cover letters and applications), interviews (Interviews, offers and pay), work-life (At work: starting, leaving, rights and ways of working), students (Students, graduates and first jobs). Without a topic it lists the shelves with how many guides each holds.

topic.description: A shelf id such as 'applying' or 'layoffs', or a few words about the subject.

name: browse_career_guides

shelves.description: Every shelf, when no topic was given.

topic.description: The shelf listed, or null for a free-text match.

total.description: How many guides the shelf holds, when more than were listed.
